owner_instruction_original: Approvo la proposal proposal-db534143fb8d4c40a73449af1adb2f7c della request scn01-teacher-10-regeneration e ne autorizzo l'applicazione, con i limiti accettati 1–3.
owner_instruction_english: I approve proposal proposal-db534143fb8d4c40a73449af1adb2f7c of request scn01-teacher-10-regeneration and authorize its application, with accepted limitations 1–3.
accepted_limitations: The improved and worse comparison prompts follow the sentence frame of the approved Greenleaf assessment prompt with new fictional facts (about 63% word overlap, including the verbatim run "Ask the customer to arrange payment within five business days and include the invoice ... and amount in the email body"). No assessment prompt body or case fact is reused exactly, and the removed sentence differs (tone, not length), but the demonstration models the same pattern learners meet in the assessment.

The peer scene presents the authored illustrative email in-fiction as what the tool returned ("this is the email it came back with"). The notice declares the whole example a newly authored illustration but does not state explicitly that the email is not real AI output.

Minor: the improved prompt adds "a small tool and equipment supplier" and a five-business-day deadline that are not declared facts, and one transcript line ("Without those details, the AI has nothing specific to put in the email") is phrased more categorically than the surrounding qualified claims.
